LipiAndes (regional holding for Lipigas/Evol Chile, Limagas GLP + Limagas Natural Peru, Chilco Colombia) acquired 70% of Ecuadorian developer Sycar; deal announced operational 26 Jun 2025, with Sycar operations now run by Limagas Natural (LipiAndes' Peru subsidiary). GEM Parent (LipiAndes 70% / Sycar LLC 30%) and Owner (Sycar - LNG SA [100%]) match. Project remains proposed: Sycar holds Ecuador's LNG/CNG marketing authorization and has imported spot LNG from Peru since 2022, but the full FSRU at Bajo Alto/Jambeli Canal has slipped (anticipated start was 2025 with no groundbreaking confirmed). NOTE: do not confuse with the separate GEM 'Jambeli FLNG Terminal' (an export project) page.
